fields.value: Land uplift modelling data including lake and mire isolation and archaeological data from Fennoscandia

dsDescriptionValue.value: The data are a collection of two data sets for modelling land uplift in Fennoscandia. One data set includes lake and mire isolation data indicating the time when the basin has isolated from the sea, the other data set includes archaeological data which is used to check the upper limit for the shoreline. The references to the original sources are included in the files.

publicationCitation.value: Lake and mire isolation data set for the estimation of post-glacial land uplift in Fennoscandia

datasetVersion.citation: Jari Pohjola et al, 2019,  Land uplift modelling data including lake and mire isolation and archaeological data from Fennoscandia, https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.905352
